model.selectedFrozenProfile: Original published FP32; no dtype conversion admitted by the original asset contract.
model.roleRetained: One supervised adaptation base; not promoted to a qualified product model.

findings: Cached official converter forces convolution and embedding tensors to F16 even when general weight_type is f32.
Native Conv1D declarations use F16 for depthwise and non-pointwise kernels; Session::load_weight converts F32 disk tensors to F16 memory tensors for these declarations.
The pinned GGML depthwise1D/2D convolution graphs request F16 im2col for F32 kernels; a custom all-F32 export alone would not preserve the original execution profile.

A native FP32 port would require converter mapping, runtime tensor declarations and convolution graph/backend verification, plus tokenizer/frontend equivalence. Stock runtime support for model family is not evidence of this exact profile.
nativeRuntime.decision: Defer a substantial native-engine FP32 port until the selected English model has accuracy-bearing adaptation evidence. Do not silently substitute Q8/FP16, launch a precision grid or treat file export as accuracy improvement.

rebootReview.priority: Compute runtime/driver/USB4 externalGPU path. Games or graphics benchmarks passing do not qualify the separate compute workload.
rebootReview.cpuTemperatureTaskPolicy: observe-only; no 85/95 software admission or abort threshold
rebootReview.nextExternalGpuComparison: Use one frozen short input and model, durable stage/operator/device/memory journal, and one changed execution condition. The already prepared graphics-driver comparison is separate and not yet installation-authorized.
